eyebrow: What the Sentinel connector brings in
code:
Microsoft Sentinel -> Data connectors
  -> Microsoft Defender XDR
     (formerly "Microsoft 365 Defender")

Brings in:
  - Correlated Defender XDR incidents
  - Advanced Hunting tables:
    DeviceProcessEvents
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    DeviceLogonEvents
    AlertInfo / AlertEvidence
caption: Real Advanced Hunting schema tables, ingested into the same Log Analytics workspace Sentinel already queries.
